#.label: Adyen (cloud) – account (preview)
Your Adyen account details for card term: Your Adyen account details for card terminals reached through Adyen's cloud. Use the target finder at the top to pick the tenant, a group or a store. Every checkout below uses these details unless it has its own, for example to use another Adyen account. Each checkout's terminal is registered under “Adyen (cloud) – terminals”.
#/properties/environment.label: Environment
#/properties/environment.description: Where payments are sent. Production means real payments. Sandbox is Adyen's test system. Mock is Extenda Retail's simulator, so nothing reaches Adyen or a terminal. Switch to Production only when the store is ready to go live.
Live mode: real cards are charged. Use i: Live mode: real cards are charged. Use it only in live stores.
Test mode: Adyen's test system answers. No real money moves.
Simulator mode: Extenda Retail's simulat: Simulator mode: Extenda Retail's simulator answers instead of Adyen. Nothing reaches a terminal.
#/properties/apiKey.label: API key
#/properties/apiKey.description: The secret key from your Adyen customer area (API credentials). Hii Connect uses it to send payments to your terminals. Treat it like a password.
Adyen reports the result of every paymen: Adyen reports the result of every payment back to Hii Connect through a webhook. Create the webhook in your Adyen customer area first, then copy its details here.
#/properties/webhook/properties/url.desc: The unique ID at the end of your webhook address, as shown when the webhook was created.
#/properties/webhook/properties/username: The username Adyen signs in with when it calls the webhook. It must match what you entered in Adyen.
#/properties/webhook/properties/password: The password Adyen signs in with when it calls the webhook. It must match what you entered in Adyen. Treat it like a password.
Fill this in only if checkouts take paym: Fill this in only if checkouts take payments with Tap to Pay on an Android phone or tablet, that is, a terminal set to “Adyen Payments app” under “Adyen (cloud) – terminals”. Otherwise leave the whole section empty. If you fill in one field, fill in every required field.
The ID of the store in Adyen where these devices are registered. Optional.
#/properties/softpos/properties/softposA: A separate API key from Adyen for Tap to Pay. Treat it like a password.
The key you share with Adyen to protect: The key you share with Adyen to protect the messages between the checkout and the device.
#/properties/softpos/properties/encrypti: The name of the encryption key. It must match the key set up for the device in Adyen.
The passphrase of that key, at least 12 characters. Treat it like a password.
The version number of the key. Leave it at 1 unless Adyen has told you otherwise.
